product_context.problem_statement: Adult patients cannot judge whether a new symptom needs emergency care, a same-day slot or self-care, so the hospital call centre queue is first-in-first-out at peak hours and a deteriorating patient can wait behind a routine question.
target_users: adult patients using the hospital patient app
triage nurses in the call centre
product_context.value_hypothesis: A structured symptom intake plus a drafted disposition lets a triage nurse decide faster with better information, so time-to-nurse-decision falls for deteriorating patients without increasing the rate of missed escalations measured in weekly nurse audits.
in_scope: structured symptom intake in Vietnamese and English
draft triage disposition proposed to the nurse queue
priority ordering of intakes that match red-flag rules
plain-language summary of what the patient reported
non_goals: paediatric triage and mental-health crisis counselling
closing or downgrading a case without a nurse decision
product_context.user_journey_moment: After the patient submits a symptom intake in the app and before the triage nurse opens that case in the call-centre console.
product_context.fallback_experience: If the assistant is unavailable, low-confidence or paused, the intake drops into the standard first-in-first-out nurse queue carrying the raw patient answers, and the app keeps showing the static red-flag card telling the patient to call 115 or go to the nearest emergency department.

system_profile.purpose: Collect a structured symptom history and draft a triage disposition that a licensed triage nurse must confirm, change or reject before anything is communicated to the patient.
user_groups: family members completing an intake for a relative
system_profile.decision_impact: The draft disposition changes how quickly a patient is called back and whether an emergency escalation is raised; a missed red flag delays time-critical treatment and that delay cannot be undone afterwards.
data_types: intake chat transcripts and nurse override notes
system_profile.deployment_context: A private hospital group in Vietnam runs the assistant inside its patient app and call-centre console, calling a vendor-hosted large language model under a data-processing agreement, with an EU launch under discussion for a partner clinic network.

system_boundary.model: vendor-hosted large language model with retrieval over the hospital's approved triage protocol, wrapped by a deterministic red-flag rule set that can only escalate and never downgrade
system_boundary.application: patient app intake flow plus nurse triage console with reason codes, override, pause and patient call-back controls
people: family members entering symptoms for a relative
vendor support engineers with production access
upstream_inputs: patient-entered symptom answers and free text
downstream_decisions: give self-care advice with a safety-net instruction

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: A missed deterioration signal at the intake moment delays time-critical care and can end in death or permanent injury, so severity and stakes are at the top of the scale. The intake carries health data, which is sensitive personal data, and free text often contains identifiers. Scale is 4 rather than 5 because the pilot covers one call centre and adult non-emergency intakes only, yet every case still routes into a decision a nurse must own, so meaningful human review is mandatory. This triage score is a product prioritisation aid, not a legal classification.

vietnam.rationale: Triage support is plausibly inside the published high-risk list and it also processes health data, but the exact workflow, our provider or deployer role and the medical-device question must be mapped against the AI Law, its implementing instruments and the personal data protection law before any production release.

eu.rationale: Health triage sits in the high-risk area of the EU framework and a software function that supports a clinical decision may also be regulated as a medical device, so counsel must confirm which route applies and which obligation dates bind us before any European clinic launch.

legal_classification.other_markets: No third market is in scope for this pilot; any launch outside Vietnam and the European Union requires a separate counsel review before build starts.

product_metrics.success_kpi: Median time from intake submission to nurse-confirmed disposition is at most 15 minutes for red-flag intakes and at most 60 minutes overall, sustained for four consecutive pilot weeks.
product_metrics.risk_kri: Under-triage rate, defined as the share of audited intakes where the nurse or the outcome review raised the assistant draft by at least one urgency level, stays at or below 2 percent weekly with no upward trend across three weeks.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Cases closed or urgency-downgraded without a recorded nurse decision must stay at exactly zero in every reporting period, and this number is never traded off against speed or queue-throughput targets.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Weekly clinical safety review during the pilot and monthly in production, plus an event-triggered review within one working day of any missed red flag, vendor or model or prompt change, protocol update, new patient population or new target market.

release_decision.independent_reviewer: Hospital Clinical Safety and Ethics Committee
release_blockers: GAP-01: Vietnam legal classification memo not yet signed, blocks production release
GAP-02: health-data lawful basis, impact assessment and vendor transfer review not finished, blocks production release
GAP-03: EU high-risk and medical-device route not determined, blocks the European clinic launch only
GAP-04: deterministic red-flag safety net not yet demonstrated end to end, blocks pilot start
GAP-05: retrospective under-triage evaluation with subgroup breakdown not yet run, blocks production release
GAP-06: nurse oversight capacity, information and override authority not yet evidenced under peak load, blocks pilot start
GAP-07: vendor change-control commitment on silent model or prompt changes not yet contracted, blocks production release
release_conditions: the assistant may only draft a disposition that a licensed triage nurse confirms, and it can never close, downgrade or send a disposition to a patient by itself
GAP-04 and GAP-06 are signed off before the first real patient intake enters the pilot
the pilot stays limited to one call centre, adult non-emergency intakes, and excludes paediatric and mental-health crisis pathways
GAP-01, GAP-02, GAP-05 and GAP-07 are closed with named evidence before any production release, and GAP-03 before any European clinic launch
an on-call clinical safety officer holds a standing authority to pause the assistant within one hour without a product or vendor approval
release_decision.next_review_trigger: Review immediately on any missed red flag, on any under-triage or guardrail threshold breach, on any vendor model or prompt change, on adding a new patient population or market, and in every case no later than 2026-11-16.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: Residual risk is accepted only for a nurse-supervised pilot: the assistant is decision-support, the deterministic red-flag rules can escalate but never downgrade, every disposition carries a nurse decision record, and the pause path stops the feature within one hour. Residual severity stays high because a delayed escalation is irreversible, so the acceptance is bounded by scope limits, weekly audits and the stop thresholds in the harm map.
